segments.sn35.155:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn35.155:1.3: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, dhammakathiko hotī”ti?
segments.sn35.155:2.1: “Cakkhussa ce, bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya dhammaṃ deseti,‘dhammakathiko bhikkhū’ti alaṃvacanāya.
segments.sn35.155:2.2: Cakkhussa ce, bhikkhu, nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti,‘dhammānudhammappaṭipanno bhikkhū’ti alaṃvacanāya.
segments.sn35.155:2.3: Cakkhussa ce, bhikkhu, nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādāvimutto hoti,‘diṭṭhadhammanibbānappatto bhikkhū’ti alaṃvacanāya … pe … jivhāya ce, bhikkhu, nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya dhammaṃ deseti,‘dhammakathiko bhikkhū’ti alaṃvacanāya … pe … manassa ce, bhikkhu, nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya dhammaṃ deseti,‘dhammakathiko bhikkhū’ti alaṃvacanāya.
segments.sn35.155:2.6: Manassa ce, bhikkhu, nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti,‘dhammānudhammappaṭipanno bhikkhū’ti alaṃvacanāya.
segments.sn35.155:2.7: Manassa ce, bhikkhu, nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādāvimutto hoti,‘diṭṭhadhammanibbānappatto bhikkhū’ti alaṃvacanāyā”ti.
segments.sn35.155:3.3: Atthi nu kho pariyāyo, indriyakathikena cāti.
segments.sn35.155:4.1: Yogakkhemi ca loko ca, gahapati devadahena ca;

lines: Tattha yena cha indriyāni sammasitvā arahattaṃ pattaṃ, so tehi nibbisevanehi indriyehi samannāgatattā, cakkhādīni vā cha indriyāni sammasantassa uppannehi saddhādīhi indriyehi samannāgatattā paripuṇṇindriyo nāma hoti, taṃ sandhāya bhagavā cakkhundriye cetiādinā nayena desanaṃ vitthāretvā ettāvatā kho bhikkhu indriyasampanno hotīti āha.
154-155. “Sampannasīlā, bhikkhave, viharathā”tiādīsu (ma. ni.1.64) viya paripuṇṇattho idha sampanna -saddoti āha “paripuṇṇindriyo”ti.
Indriyehi samannāgatattā paripuṇṇindriyo nāma hotīti sambandho.
Evaṃ sati samannāgamasampatti vuttā hotīti āsaṅkanto “cakkhādīni vā”tiādimāha.
Heṭṭhā khandhiyavagge khandhavasena desanā āgatā, idha āyatanavasenāti āha “vuttanayamevā”ti.
